notable_features.text: Basque is famous as Europe's only language isolate, with no demonstrated relatives among surviving languages, and is considered the last living descendant of a pre-Indo-European Paleo-European language. It uses a strict SOV word order and has a notably rich verbal system, marking seven distinct tense/aspect categories, alongside a relatively large phoneme inventory of 43 sounds.
